query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as projects_under_5_tags
FROM (
  SELECT p.id
  FROM projects p
  LEFT JOIN projectTags pt ON p.id = pt.projectId
  GROUP BY p.id
  HAVING COUNT(pt.tagId) < 5
) as subquery;
